0.content: "Princess Lyris" is the figure in the hero Narzissenkreuz fairy tale that Alain had the Institute children act out. Mary-Ann told Lyris a version in which the princess sacrificed her "time", fell asleep and promised her friends would carry her future. The Oceanid Ann calls herself the hero rescuing Princess Lyris. "Red Empress" is her Ordo title; Caterpillar calls the head-taking a metaphor for her power to dissolve and extract wills.
